title: Roasted Duck with Asian Glaze
description: A sweet and savory roasted duck dish with a Chinese-inspired glaze. This recipe is perfect for a special occasion or dinner party.
instructions: Rinse the duck and pat it dry with paper towels.
In a small bowl, whisk together honey, soy sauce, five-spice powder, and water.
Place the duck in a roasting pan and brush the glaze all over the skin.
Roast the duck in the preheated oven for 20 minutes.
Reduce the oven temperature to 375°F (190°C) and continue roasting for an additional 30-40 minutes, or until the skin is crispy and golden brown.
Remove the duck from the oven and let it rest for 10 minutes before carving.
Serve the duck with the pan juices spooned over the top.
